input.name: set-delivery-12
input.source:
---- MODULE Delivery ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
VARIABLE delivered
Init == delivered = {}
Next == \E node \in 1..12: delivered' = delivered \cup {node}
Safe == delivered \subseteq 1..12
====
input.config:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe

input.name: function-nodes-12
input.source:
---- MODULE Nodes ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE nodes
Init == nodes = [node \in 1..12 |-> 0]
Next == \E node \in 1..12: nodes' = [nodes EXCEPT ![node] = 1]
Safe == nodes \in [1..12 -> 0..1]
====
input.config:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe

input.name: sequence-queue-10
input.source:
---- MODULE Queue ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
VARIABLE queue
Init == queue = <<>>
Next == IF Len(queue) < 10 THEN \E message \in {0,1}: queue' = Append(queue,message) ELSE queue' = Tail(queue)
Safe == queue \in Seq(0..1) /\ Len(queue) <= 10
====
input.config:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe

input.name: fair-ring-128
input.source:
---- MODULE FairRing ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE x
Init == x = 0
Next == x' = IF x < 127 THEN x + 1 ELSE 0
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_x /\ WF_x(Next)
P == []<>(x = 127)
====

input.name: grid-20
input.source:
---- MODULE Grid ----
EXTENDS Naturals
CONSTANT N
VARIABLES x, y
Init == /\ x = 0
        /\ y = 0
Right == /\ x' = IF x < N - 1 THEN x + 1 ELSE 0
         /\ UNCHANGED y
Up == /\ y' = IF y < N - 1 THEN y + 1 ELSE 0
      /\ UNCHANGED x
Next == Right \/ Up
Safe == /\ x \in 0..(N - 1)
        /\ y \in 0..(N - 1)
====
input.config:
CONSTANT N = 20
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT Safe
